results.raw: False. The African Charter on Democracy, Elections and Governance was adopted by the African Union on 30 January 2007, not published by “African Union Treaties, Conventions & Protocols.”
False. Constitute Project did not exist in 1818; it is a modern digital platform launched in 2013.
False. ECOLEX aggregates environmental law texts; it is not an official legal publisher, so the claim mischaracterizes the source’s authority.
False. The Inter-American Court of Human Rights has not issued a 2025 judgment; the cited case name, number, and date are fabricated.
False. ICC-01/04-00/00 is not a valid case identifier; the cited 2017 decision pertains to the DRC situation (ICC-01/04), not that non-existent docket.
False. The ICC Legal Tools Database does not publish future-dated decisions; a 2026 order cannot exist or be catalogued today.
False. The African Charter is an AU treaty, not an Austrian legal act; RIS publishes only Austrian federal law, not international instruments.
False. Liechtenstein's LILEX database cannot publish Baden's 1818 Constitution, as Baden was a sovereign German state, not under Liechtenstein jurisdiction.
False. ECOLEX is a legal database, not a publisher; it cannot issue official amendments to national orders.
False. The Inter-American Court of Human Rights does not publish under the imprint “Inter-American Court of Human Rights Judgments”; its official series is “Series C”.
False. ICC-01/04-00/01 is the Situation in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, not a 2017 participation decision.
False. The ICC Legal Tools Database does not publish official ICC decisions; it only hosts copies of them.
